title: Open AI says employee caught planting listening device
summary: A Saudi national employed by the artificial intelligence lab has been arrested after a listening device was planted in an office.

image.caption: A listening device was found late last month, OpenAI saidImage: Jonathan Raa/NurPhoto/picture alliance

blocks.text: OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, said Tuesday one of its employees was arrested after an investigation uncovered a "sophisticated recording device" in one of its San Francisco offices.
The US Justice Department said OpenAI's security team found the device late last month, and the employee, a Saudi national, was arrested.
Officials said the person was charged with using a device to intercept oral communications.
